title: Day Care balls, Market alerts and Guild ranking
notes: Day Care: pick which ball your baby hatches in.
PC: sort by Rarest in the world, and show only Pokémon with under 100 in the world.
Market alerts: tap the bell on a Night Market listing to save it. You get a message when a matching one is listed.
Guild ranking: a new Ranking tab shows every guild by War Power.
Stacks: send one or all but the best to the Professor from the stack card, a Stacks filter in the PC, each one's nature in the list, and a Show stacks switch in Settings.
fixes: Releasing from a stack now shows what you were paid.
Fixes: Flatter, Encore quests, the phone Encore layout, auto-file rules, gifts after switching device, Full Art world counts and odd evolutions.

title: Stacks and Co-op Tower
notes: Stacks: matching Pokémon in your PC now share one tile with a number. Tap a stack to open it, or hold to lift one to move.
Co-op Tower: climb the Tower with a friend in a two-on-two battle. Invite a friend from the Tower screen and take catches home. Opens with your 3rd Gym badge.
Night Market History now shows the forge marks.
Spare Full Art card Pokémon can now be sent together in one go.
New looks: Gilded Prismatic now turns through every colour, Mirage Gilded is Golden Hour and Mirage Prismatic is Rainbow Haze. Safari catches now stack too.
fixes: Everstone now stops the evolve offer in manual battles.
Phone: the hearts on Friends rows work for friends with a guild tag.
The share card now shows Gilded and Glitched looks.
Some back sprites were drawn at the wrong size; they are fixed.
The Boss War planner no longer blocks clicks, and Altar pages keep their place.

title: Gender Swap, Ability Capsule and a new tutorial
notes: Glimmer Shop: Gender Swap (50,000 Glimmer) and Ability Capsule (75,000 Glimmer) are on the Training shelf, one of each a week. Pick a Pokémon in your PC, then Use.
New players get a new tutorial: a hello from your partner and a short tip the first time each place opens. Settings > Help turns tips off or plays it again.
Trades: offer cards and requests now show every rare look, like Gilded, Glitched and Mirage. If an asked-for Pokémon’s look changes before the trade, the offer is cancelled.
Day Care: Mirage and Glitched helpers now count like Spectral ones.
Breeding with a Full Art card: a baby that can carry the same card now gets it 1 in 10 (was 1 in 20). Two carded parents are still 1 in 10.
Auctions and Market history: new Mirage and Spectral filters.
Web: the game keeps hunting while its tab is in the background.
The Bottle Cap mark now also shows in Auctions, trade offers, online tiles and friends’ PCs.
fixes: Windows: the game no longer jumps in front of Snipping Tool.
Full Art cards opened inside a trade can be closed again.
The Night Market and the Friends list are faster.
Small display fixes: your Buddy on Friends cards opens when clicked, tap-to-move works on iPhone and iPad, and Mythic card previews fit small windows.
